correctness.rationale: For axial triangle T(a,b,c) with ordered positive axes, reconstructed normalized lattice double-area D=gcd(ab,ac,bc), boundary lengths gcd pairs, and Pick formula 2I=D−gcd(a,b)−gcd(b,c)−gcd(c,a)+2. With g=gcd(a,b,c) and pairwise-coprime sorted pair-GCD ratios (u,v,w), derived 2I=g²uvw−g(u+v+w)+2 and completed all gcd patterns I≤2. Independently enumerated 4,913 triples with 1≤a,b,c≤17 and compared the integer equation x/a+y/b+z/c=1 with Pick classification. Local prime probabilities e_p=1−3/p²+2/p³ and h_p=1−2/p²+1/p³ and explicit exceptional valuation ratios yield d0=3Q−15P/8, d1=(3583/17280)P and d2=(151/2100)P. The CRT proves each finite-prime density, while probability of an unprescribed prime >Y dividing two coordinates is ≤3/Y uniformly, establishing the unlimited box limits; finite checks are supplementary.
